newsitem.title: LATVIA: JEKABPILS SUGAR BACK IN 1996 PROFIT.
newsitem.headline: JEKABPILS SUGAR BACK IN 1996 PROFIT.

text.p: Jekabpils sugar factory on Monday said that it was back in profit in 1996, registering after-tax profit of 30,011 lats against losses of 172,514 lats.
The company's turnover in 1996 was 3.47 million lats against 2.93 million lats the year before.

"Our after-tax profit came to 30,011 lats last year which our shareholders' meeting last week decided to invest in modernising the factory, reconstructing the filtering unit," Jekabpils' manager Peteris Lazdinsh told Reuters.
Lazdinsh said these were the figures approved at the company's annual shareholder meeting on Friday.
